Monetary policy assessment

as of 19 June 2026

Economic conditions

The Swiss economy is expected to grow by 1.2 per cent in 2026. Economic activity remains moderate.

Inflation outlook

Inflation is projected to average 1.1 per cent in 2026. Underlying inflation remains moderate.

Monetary policy conditions

The SNB is continuing to ensure appropriate monetary conditions over the medium term. The SNB will continue to monitor the situation closely.

Risks

Assuming this monetary policy, the risks to the Swiss economy are tilted to the downside.
